agentStop.bash: osascript -e 'do shell script "afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff &> /dev/null &"' -e 'display dialog "Agent stopped." with title "Hook-generated message" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

sessionEnd.bash: osascript -e 'do shell script "afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff &> /dev/null &"' -e 'display dialog "Session ended." with title "Hook-generated message" buttons {"OK"} default button "OK"'

permissionRequest.bash: say "Copilot needs permission to use a tool." &> /dev/null &
